description: M/of Youth Affairs and Sports- Appointed the Secretary to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports as the Competent Authority
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, including the temporary suspension of National Sports Associations/Federations and appointment of a competent authority. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks under existing legislation, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
